messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — candidate for Senior Backend on Tue 10:00am PT needs panel coverage (30m). Can someone cover or swap? Please react :hand: if you can take it. Also reminder: submit the eval form within 24h after the interview.

Sam: I can take that slot. Taking it now. :thumbsup:

Maria: I can step in if Sam has a conflict later. Quick rubric q: for this role do we emphasize system design or coding?

Priya: Thanks Sam! @Maria — use the Senior Eng rubric (link below). Weighting we ask for is: 50% technical (coding + systems), 25% design/architecture, 25% collaboration/ownership. Use behavior anchors in the comment field.

Priya: Rubric link: https://redwood.example.com/rubrics/senior-eng (please use the "mid-senior" template)

Lee: Small ask — can we record the session for the scribe? Candidate consent already on file, right?

Devon: I confirmed consent in Greenhouse earlier. I'll be the scribe and take notes + timestamps. @Priya, do you want the short anchor bullets or full prose?

Priya: Short anchor bullets are perfect. Use this pattern in the notes: 
```
- Score: 1-5
- Quick anchor: 1 sentence rationale
- Action items / red flags (if any)
```

Maria: Got it. For clarity: when marking "technical" score, include both algorithmic correctness and code quality in the same number?

Priya: Yes — combine them into the technical score. If you want to call out separate sub-scores, put them in the comment but keep the single numeric field for the rubric.

Sam: One more: should we ask the candidate a quick follow-up on observability experience? I have a short prompt I can use.

Priya: Good idea. Use this two-line prompt: "Tell us about a time you debugged a production incident — what tools, what was your playbook, and what did you change afterward?" Keep it to 5-7 minutes.

interview-bot: Reminder scheduled: Eval form auto-reminder will ping panel 8 hours after interview if any responses missing.

Devon: Confirmed — I'll post timestamps and the short anchors in #interview-notes channel within 30m after the call.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll review the rubric before the interview and be ready for the observability prompt.

Priya: Awesome — Sam + Devon confirmed. If anything changes, post here. Otherwise I'll close the loop tomorrow AM with the calendar updates. :white_check_mark:
